-- Get the sum of the 4 5-day symmetric moving averages for Dec 5-8, 2018
-- First get all predictions, then filter
WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) as sale_date,
        SUM(oi.price) as daily_sales
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
    WHERE pct.product_category_name_english = 'toys'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS DATE)
),
regression_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, CAST(sale_date AS DATE) - DATE '2017-01-01') as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, CAST(sale_date AS DATE) - DATE '2017-01-01') as intercept
    FROM daily_sales
),
predicted_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        d.target_date,
        d.target_date - DATE '2017-01-01' as day_number,
        rp.slope * (d.target_date - DATE '2017-01-01') + rp.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM (SELECT UNNEST([DATE '2018-12-03', DATE '2018-12-04', DATE '2018-12-05', DATE '2018-12-06', DATE '2018-12-07', DATE '2018-12-08', DATE '2018-12-09', DATE '2018-12-10']) as target_date) d
    CROSS JOIN regression_params rp
),
with_ma AS (
    SELECT 
        target_date,
        predicted_sales,
        AVG(predicted_sales) OVER (ORDER BY target_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) as ma_5day
    FROM predicted_sales
)
SELECT 
    SUM(ma_5day) as sum_of_4_moving_averages
FROM with_ma
WHERE target_date BETWEEN DATE '2018-12-05' AND DATE '2018-12-08';

-- Final RFM analysis grouped by customer_unique_id
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.customer_unique_id,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS order_ts,
        op.payment_value
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_rfm AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        -- For customers with multiple customer_ids, pick one (any)
        MAX(customer_id) AS customer_id,
        CAST(DATEDIFF('day', MAX(order_ts), TIMESTAMP '2018-10-17 00:00:00') AS INTEGER) AS recency_days,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS frequency,
        SUM(payment_value) AS monetary,
        SUM(payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_sales_per_order
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
rfm_scored AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        customer_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days ASC) AS r_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency ASC) AS f_score,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary ASC) AS m_score
    FROM customer_rfm
),
rfm_with_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_unique_id,
        customer_id,
        recency_days,
        frequency,
        monetary,
        avg_sales_per_order,
        r_score,
        f_score,
        m_score,
        CAST(r_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(f_score AS VARCHAR) || CAST(m_score AS VARCHAR) AS rfm_score,
        CASE
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
            WHEN r_score IN (4, 5) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
            WHEN r_score IN (2, 3) AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
            WHEN (r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 6)
              OR (r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
            WHEN r_score = 1 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
            WHEN r_score = 2 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
            WHEN r_score = 3 AND (f_score + m_score) BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS rfm_segment
    FROM rfm_scored
)
SELECT 
    rfm_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS num_customers,
    ROUND(AVG(recency_days), 2) AS avg_recency_days,
    ROUND(AVG(frequency), 2) AS avg_frequency,
    ROUND(AVG(monetary), 2) AS avg_monetary,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_sales_per_order), 2) AS avg_sales_per_order
FROM rfm_with_segment
GROUP BY rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sales_per_order DESC

-- Every customer has exactly 1 order, so all lifespan_weeks will be 1.0 (since same day = 0 days diff, 0/7 < 1, so 1.0)
-- The top 3 customers by avg_payment_per_order are already identified.
-- Now let me build the final query with both customer_id and customer_unique_id as requested in the guidelines

WITH customer_order_payments AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_id,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp,
        COALESCE(SUM(op.payment_value), 0) AS total_payment_for_order
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp
),
customer_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS num_orders,
        SUM(total_payment_for_order) AS total_payment,
        SUM(total_payment_for_order) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_payment_per_order,
        MIN(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS earliest_purchase,
        MAX(CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS latest_purchase
    FROM customer_order_payments
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    cs.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    cs.num_orders,
    cs.avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE 
        WHEN (CAST(cs.latest_purchase AS DATE) - CAST(cs.earliest_purchase AS DATE)) / 7.0 < 1.0 THEN 1.0
        ELSE (CAST(cs.latest_purchase AS DATE) - CAST(cs.earliest_purchase AS DATE)) / 7.0
    END AS lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_stats cs
JOIN customers c ON cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY cs.avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

-- Now compute the average career span across all players with both debut and final_game
SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(
        ROUND(ABS(date_part('year', age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE))))::DOUBLE, 2) 
        + ROUND(ABS(date_part('month', age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE))))::DOUBLE / 12.0, 2) 
        + ROUND(ABS(date_part('day', age(CAST(final_game AS DATE), CAST(debut AS DATE))))::DOUBLE / 365.0, 2)
    ), 2) as avg_career_span
FROM player 
WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND debut != '' 
  AND final_game IS NOT NULL AND final_game != ''

SELECT p.name_given, rh.player_id, rh.category,
  CASE WHEN rh.category = 'games' THEN rh.g
       WHEN rh.category = 'runs' THEN rh.r
       WHEN rh.category = 'hits' THEN rh.h
       WHEN rh.category = 'home_runs' THEN rh.hr
  END as score_value
FROM (
  SELECT player_id, year, TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) as g, TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) as r, TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) as h, TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) as hr, 'games' as category FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, year, TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) as g, TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) as r, TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) as h, TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) as hr, 'runs' as category FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, year, TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) as g, TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) as r, TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) as h, TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) as hr, 'hits' as category FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT player_id, year, TRY_CAST(g AS INTEGER) as g, TRY_CAST(r AS INTEGER) as r, TRY_CAST(h AS INTEGER) as h, TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) as hr, 'home_runs' as category FROM batting WHERE TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(TRY_CAST(hr AS INTEGER)) FROM batting)
) rh
JOIN player p ON rh.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY rh.category

WITH route_distances AS (
  SELECT 
    f.departure_airport,
    f.arrival_airport,
    dep.city as dep_city,
    arr.city as arr_city,
    TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR) as dep_coords_str,
    TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR) as arr_coords_str,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, INSTR(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',') - 2) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), INSTR(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',') + 1, LENGTH(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - INSTR(TRY_CAST(dep.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',') - 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), 2, INSTR(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',') - 2) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), INSTR(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',') + 1, LENGTH(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR)) - INSTR(TRY_CAST(arr.coordinates AS VARCHAR), ',') - 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
  JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
  WHERE dep.city LIKE '%Abakan%' OR arr.city LIKE '%Abakan%'
)
SELECT MAX(
  6371 * 2 * ASIN(SQRT(
    POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) +
    COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) *
    COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) *
    POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
  ))
) as max_distance_km
FROM route_distances

-- Verify: find the range with the fewest pairs
WITH flight_airports AS (
    SELECT 
        f.flight_id,
        dep.city::VARCHAR as dep_city_json,
        arr.city::VARCHAR as arr_city_json,
        dep.coordinates::VARCHAR as dep_coords,
        arr.coordinates::VARCHAR as arr_coords
    FROM flights f
    JOIN airports_data dep ON f.departure_airport = dep.airport_code
    JOIN airports_data arr ON f.arrival_airport = arr.airport_code
),
coords AS (
    SELECT 
        flight_id,
        TRY_CAST(dep_city_json->>'en' AS VARCHAR) as dep_city,
        TRY_CAST(arr_city_json->>'en' AS VARCHAR) as arr_city,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, LENGTH(dep_coords)-2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(dep_coords, 2, LENGTH(dep_coords)-2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as dep_lat,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, LENGTH(arr_coords)-2), ',', 1) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lon,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(SUBSTR(arr_coords, 2, LENGTH(arr_coords)-2), ',', 2) AS DOUBLE) as arr_lat
    FROM flight_airports
),
distances AS (
    SELECT 
        flight_id,
        dep_city,
        arr_city,
        (2 * 6371 * ASIN(SQRT(
            POWER(SIN((arr_lat - dep_lat) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2) + 
            COS(dep_lat * PI() / 180) * COS(arr_lat * PI() / 180) * 
            POWER(SIN((arr_lon - dep_lon) * PI() / 180 / 2), 2)
        ))) as distance_km
    FROM coords
),
city_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN dep_city ELSE arr_city END as city1,
        CASE WHEN dep_city < arr_city THEN arr_city ELSE dep_city END as city2,
        distance_km
    FROM distances
),
avg_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        city1,
        city2,
        AVG(distance_km) as avg_distance
    FROM city_pairs
    GROUP BY city1, city2
),
with_ranges AS (
    SELECT 
        city1,
        city2,
        avg_distance,
        CASE 
            WHEN avg_distance < 1000 THEN '0'
            WHEN avg_distance < 2000 THEN '1000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 3000 THEN '2000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 4000 THEN '3000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 5000 THEN '4000'
            WHEN avg_distance < 6000 THEN '5000'
            ELSE '6000+'
        END as distance_range
    FROM avg_distances
),
range_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        distance_range,
        COUNT(*) as pair_count
    FROM with_ranges
    GROUP BY distance_range
)
SELECT MIN(pair_count) as fewest_pairs
FROM range_counts

-- Final calculation: fatality rate for motorcycle collisions by helmet usage
-- Using motorcycle parties only, determining helmet status from their safety equipment
WITH moto_data AS (
    SELECT 
        p.case_id,
        p.party_number_killed,
        CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_1, '')) LIKE '%helmet used%' 
                 OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_2, '')) LIKE '%helmet used%' 
            THEN 'wearing helmets'
            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_1, '')) LIKE '%helmet not used%' 
                 OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.party_safety_equipment_2, '')) LIKE '%helmet not used%' 
            THEN 'not wearing helmets'
            ELSE 'unknown'
        END as helmet_status
    FROM parties p
    JOIN collisions c ON p.case_id = c.case_id
    WHERE p.statewide_vehicle_type = 'motorcycle or scooter'
    AND c.motorcycle_collision = 1
)
SELECT 
    helmet_status,
    COUNT(*) as total_collisions,
    SUM(CASE WHEN party_number_killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as motorcyclist_fatalities,
    ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN party_number_killed > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as fatality_rate_pct
FROM moto_data
WHERE helmet_status IN ('wearing helmets', 'not wearing helmets')
GROUP BY helmet_status
ORDER BY helmet_status

WITH collision_year AS (
  SELECT 
    c.primary_collision_factor,
    CAST(SUBSTR(c.collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as coll_year,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM collisions c
  WHERE c.primary_collision_factor IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY coll_year, c.primary_collision_factor
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    coll_year,
    primary_collision_factor,
    cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY coll_year ORDER BY cnt DESC, primary_collision_factor) as rn
  FROM collision_year
),
top2 AS (
  SELECT coll_year, 
         STRING_AGG(primary_collision_factor, '|' ORDER BY rn) as pair
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn <= 2
  GROUP BY coll_year
),
majority_pair AS (
  SELECT pair
  FROM top2
  GROUP BY pair
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.coll_year
FROM top2 t, majority_pair m
WHERE t.pair != m.pair
ORDER BY t.coll_year
LIMIT 1

WITH shares AS (
    SELECT 
        '2021' as yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as pct
    FROM collisions
    WHERE strftime('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) = '2021'
      AND pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
      AND pcf_violation_category != ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        '2011' as yr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pcf_violation_category = 'speeding' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as pct
    FROM collisions
    WHERE strftime('%Y', CAST(collision_date AS DATE)) = '2011'
      AND pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL
      AND pcf_violation_category != ''
)
SELECT 
    'speeding' as primary_collision_factor_category,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2021' THEN pct END) as pct_2021,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2011' THEN pct END) as pct_2011,
    MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2011' THEN pct END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = '2021' THEN pct END) as decrease_percentage_points
FROM shares

SELECT DISTINCT w1.name as winner_name, w2.name as loser_name FROM Matches m JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.winner_id = w1.id JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.loser_id = w2.id WHERE m.title_id = 23153 AND m.title_change = 0 AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, 1, INSTR(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.duration, INSTR(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) = 43

-- Final query: bowler with lowest bowling average
WITH runs_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
extras_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, SUM(e.extra_runs) as extras
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.over_id = e.over_id AND b.ball_id = e.ball_id AND b.innings_no = e.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
),
wickets_per_bowler AS (
    SELECT b.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON w.match_id = b.match_id AND w.over_id = b.over_id AND w.ball_id = b.ball_id AND w.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name, 
       r.runs_off_bat + COALESCE(e.extras, 0) as total_runs_conceded,
       w.wickets,
       1.0 * (r.runs_off_bat + COALESCE(e.extras, 0)) / w.wickets as bowling_average
FROM runs_per_bowler r
LEFT JOIN extras_per_bowler e ON r.bowler = e.bowler
JOIN wickets_per_bowler w ON r.bowler = w.bowler
JOIN player p ON r.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

-- Calculate the average of total runs scored by all qualifying strikers
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.striker,
        b.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b 
        ON bs.match_id = b.match_id
        AND bs.over_id = b.over_id
        AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id
        AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE total_runs > 50
),
striker_grand_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        qmr.striker,
        SUM(qmr.total_runs) as grand_total_runs
    FROM striker_match_runs qmr
    JOIN qualifying_strikers qs ON qmr.striker = qs.striker
    GROUP BY qmr.striker
)
SELECT AVG(grand_total_runs) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_grand_totals;

-- Final query: Get distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs while playing for the losing team
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.match_id, bb.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs 
      ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
      AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.match_id, bb.striker
),
player_match_team AS (
    SELECT pmr.match_id, pmr.player_id, pmr.total_runs, pm.team_id
    FROM player_match_runs pmr
    JOIN player_match pm 
      ON pmr.match_id = pm.match_id 
      AND pmr.player_id = pm.player_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player_match_team pmt
JOIN match m ON pmt.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmt.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmt.total_runs >= 100
  AND pmt.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name

-- Final query: Top 5 players by batting average (runs/dismissals) in season 5
WITH season5_runs AS (
    SELECT b.striker as player_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND b.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    JOIN match m ON b.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY b.striker
),
season5_dismissals AS (
    SELECT w.player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN match m ON w.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season_id = 5
    GROUP BY w.player_out
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    1.0 * r.total_runs / d.dismissals as batting_average
FROM season5_runs r
JOIN season5_dismissals d ON r.player_id = d.player_id
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY 1.0 * r.total_runs / d.dismissals DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final query: Top 5 countries by average of player average runs per match
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.striker as player_id,
        bbb.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_in_match
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
        ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),
player_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_in_match) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT 
    p.country_name,
    AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) as country_avg_runs
FROM player_avg pa
JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY p.country_name
ORDER BY country_avg_runs DESC
LIMIT 5

-- Final answer: average of highest over totals across all matches
WITH batsman_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, SUM(runs_scored) as batsman_runs
    FROM batsman_scored
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
extra_over AS (
    SELECT match_id, over_id, innings_no, SUM(extra_runs) as extra_runs
    FROM extra_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, over_id, innings_no
),
all_overs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, over_id, innings_no FROM ball_by_ball
),
over_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ao.match_id,
        ao.over_id,
        ao.innings_no,
        COALESCE(bo.batsman_runs, 0) as batsman_runs,
        COALESCE(eo.extra_runs, 0) as extra_runs,
        COALESCE(bo.batsman_runs, 0) + COALESCE(eo.extra_runs, 0) as total_runs
    FROM all_overs ao
    LEFT JOIN batsman_over bo ON ao.match_id = bo.match_id AND ao.over_id = bo.over_id AND ao.innings_no = bo.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_over eo ON ao.match_id = eo.match_id AND ao.over_id = eo.over_id AND ao.innings_no = eo.innings_no
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT *,

    FROM over_totals
),
best_over AS (

    FROM ranked_overs
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as avg_highest_over_total

-- Final query: top 3 bowlers by their best qualifying over
WITH over_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        b.match_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.innings_no,
        b.bowler,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) + SUM(COALESCE(er.extra_runs, 0)) as total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON b.match_id = er.match_id AND b.over_id = er.over_id AND b.ball_id = er.ball_id AND b.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.over_id, b.innings_no, b.bowler
),
max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs) as max_runs
    FROM over_runs
    GROUP BY match_id
),
qualifying_overs AS (
    SELECT 
        o.match_id,
        o.over_id,
        o.innings_no,
        o.bowler,
        o.total_runs
    FROM over_runs o
    JOIN max_runs_per_match m ON o.match_id = m.match_id AND o.total_runs = m.max_runs
),
bowler_best AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        match_id,
        total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY total_runs DESC, match_id ASC) as rn
    FROM qualifying_overs
),
bowler_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        bb.match_id,
        bb.total_runs,
        p.player_name,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bb.total_runs DESC, bb.match_id ASC) as overall_rn
    FROM bowler_best bb
    JOIN player p ON bb.bowler = p.player_id
    WHERE bb.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    player_name,
    match_id,
    CAST(total_runs AS INTEGER) as runs
FROM bowler_ranked
WHERE overall_rn <= 3
ORDER BY runs DESC

delivered_counts AS (

ranked AS (

WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lat,
        LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_lng,
        LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_city,
        LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) AS prev_state
    FROM olist_geolocation
),
distances AS (
    SELECT 
        prev_state,
        prev_city,
        geolocation_state,
        geolocation_city,
        6371 * acos(
            GREATEST(LEAST(
                cos(radians(prev_lat)) * cos(radians(geolocation_lat)) * cos(radians(geolocation_lng) - radians(prev_lng)) +
                sin(radians(prev_lat)) * sin(radians(geolocation_lat)),
                1.0
            ), -1.0)
        ) AS distance_km
    FROM ordered
    WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    prev_city AS first_city,
    prev_state AS first_state,
    geolocation_city AS second_city,
    geolocation_state AS second_state,
    distance_km
FROM distances
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Calculate median of monthly averages
WITH france_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_year,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
      AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
projected AS (
    SELECT 
        p2019.prod_id,
        p2019.calendar_month_number,
        p2019.monthly_sales as sales_2019,
        p2020.monthly_sales as sales_2020,
        ((p2020.monthly_sales - p2019.monthly_sales) / p2019.monthly_sales) * p2020.monthly_sales + p2020.monthly_sales as projected_2021_local
    FROM france_sales p2019
    JOIN france_sales p2020 
        ON p2019.prod_id = p2020.prod_id 
        AND p2019.calendar_month_number = p2020.calendar_month_number
        AND p2019.calendar_year = 2019
        AND p2020.calendar_year = 2020
),
with_currency AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.prod_id,
        pr.calendar_month_number,
        pr.projected_2021_local * c.to_us as projected_2021_usd
    FROM projected pr
    JOIN currency c ON c.country = 'France' 
        AND c.year = 2021 
        AND c.month = pr.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        calendar_month_number,
        ROUND(AVG(projected_2021_usd), 2) as avg_monthly_usd
    FROM with_currency
    GROUP BY calendar_month_number
)
SELECT MEDIAN(avg_monthly_usd) as median_monthly_usd
FROM monthly_averages

WITH artist_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        a.ArtistId,
        ar.Name AS ArtistName,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_sales
    FROM artists ar
    JOIN albums a ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    JOIN tracks t ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    GROUP BY a.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales
    ORDER BY total_sales DESC, ArtistName ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales
    ORDER BY total_sales ASC, ArtistName ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        inv.CustomerId,
        ar.ArtistId,
        ar.Name AS ArtistName,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS customer_artist_spending
    FROM invoice_items ii
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
    JOIN artists ar ON a.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    WHERE ar.ArtistId IN (
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist),
        (SELECT ArtistId FROM lowest_artist)
    )
    GROUP BY inv.CustomerId, ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
avg_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        ArtistId,
        ArtistName,
        AVG(customer_artist_spending) AS avg_customer_spending
    FROM customer_spending
    GROUP BY ArtistId, ArtistName
)
SELECT 
    ABS(top_avg.avg_customer_spending - low_avg.avg_customer_spending) AS absolute_difference
FROM avg_spending top_avg
JOIN avg_spending low_avg ON top_avg.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)
    AND low_avg.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM lowest_artist)

-- Full query to find the customer with the highest average monthly change
WITH monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    date_trunc('month', payment_date) as payment_month,
    SUM(amount) as total_amount
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month,
    total_amount,
    LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_amount
  FROM monthly_payments
),
changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month,
    total_amount,
    prev_amount,
    total_amount - prev_amount as monthly_change
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE prev_amount IS NOT NULL
),
avg_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    AVG(monthly_change) as avg_monthly_change
  FROM changes
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
  ac.customer_id,
  c.first_name,
  c.last_name,
  ac.avg_monthly_change
FROM avg_changes ac
JOIN customer c ON ac.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY ac.avg_monthly_change DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Final query
WITH city_sales AS (
  SELECT c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
  GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
city_comparison AS (
  SELECT cust_city,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN total_sales END) as sales_2019_q4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN total_sales END) as sales_2020_q4
  FROM city_sales
  GROUP BY cust_city
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN total_sales END) > 0
),
qualifying_cities AS (
  SELECT cust_city
  FROM city_comparison
  WHERE (sales_2020_q4 - sales_2019_q4) * 1.0 / sales_2019_q4 >= 0.20
),
product_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name,
    t.calendar_quarter_desc,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) as product_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
  GROUP BY p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
total_quarter_sales AS (
  SELECT t.calendar_quarter_desc, SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN qualifying_cities qc ON c.cust_city = qc.cust_city
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_desc IN ('2019-04', '2020-04')
  GROUP BY t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
product_total_sales AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_name, SUM(product_sales) as total_sales
  FROM product_quarter_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, prod_name
),
product_ranked AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_name, total_sales,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as ntile_group
  FROM product_total_sales
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_name, total_sales
  FROM product_ranked
  WHERE ntile_group = 1
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT tp.prod_id, tp.prod_name,
    pq.calendar_quarter_desc,
    pq.product_sales,
    tq.total_sales as quarter_total,
    pq.product_sales * 1.0 / tq.total_sales as share
  FROM top_products tp
  JOIN product_quarter_sales pq ON tp.prod_id = pq.prod_id
  JOIN total_quarter_sales tq ON pq.calendar_quarter_desc = tq.calendar_quarter_desc
),
share_pivot AS (
  SELECT prod_id, prod_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN share END) as share_2019_q4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN share END) as share_2020_q4
  FROM product_shares

        strftime(CAST(insert_date AS DATE), '%B') AS month_name,

    FROM cities
    WHERE CAST(insert_date AS DATE) BETWEEN '2021-04-01' AND '2023-06-30'
      AND CAST(strftime(CAST(insert_date AS DATE), '%m') AS INTEGER) IN (4, 5, 6)
    GROUP BY year, month_num, month_name

with_running_total AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.*,
        SUM(mc.city_count) OVER (
            PARTITION BY mc.month_num 
            ORDER BY mc.year
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS running_total
    FROM monthly_counts mc
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        wr.*,
        -- YoY growth for monthly total
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(wr.city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wr.month_num ORDER BY wr.year) IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1.0 * (wr.city_count - LAG(wr.city_count) OVER (PARTITION BY wr.month_num ORDER BY wr.year))

            ELSE NULL

        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(wr.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY wr.month_num ORDER BY wr.year) IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1.0 * (wr.running_total - LAG(wr.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY wr.month_num ORDER BY wr.year)) 
                 / LAG(wr.running_total) OVER (PARTITION BY wr.month_num ORDER BY wr.year) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END AS running_total_growth_pct
    FROM with_running_total wr
)

    GROUP BY im.month_year, im._month, im._year, im.interest_id
),
top_per_month AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        _month,
        _year,
        interest_id,

    FROM monthly_avg

        tpm.month_year,
        tpm._month,
        tpm._year,
        im_map.interest_name,
        tpm.avg_composition_index AS max_index_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tpm._year, tpm._month) AS month_seq
    FROM top_per_month tpm
    JOIN interest_map im_map ON CAST(tpm.interest_id AS BIGINT) = im_map.id
    WHERE tpm.rn = 1
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,

        AVG(max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY month_seq

        LAG(interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) AS prev1_interest_name,
        LAG(max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) AS prev1_max_index_composition,

        LAG(max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY month_seq) AS prev2_max_index_composition
    FROM top_interests
)

       prev1_interest_name, prev1_max_index_composition,
       prev2_interest_name, prev2_max_index_composition
FROM with_lag

ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.month_year,
        mc.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition DESC) as top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition ASC) as bottom_rank
    FROM max_composition mc
    WHERE mc.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    r.month_year as time,
    im.interest_name,
    r.composition,
    r.top_rank,
    r.bottom_rank
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map im ON CAST(r.interest_id AS INTEGER) = im.id
WHERE r.top_rank <= 10 OR r.bottom_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.composition DESC

WITH customer_spending AS (

),
customer_groups AS (

total_count AS (

SELECT

-- Final query: for each year, count total movies and percentage with exclusively female actors
WITH movie_cast_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        m.MID,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) AS year_num,
        COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(mc.PID)) AS total_cast,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Gender = 'Female' THEN TRIM(mc.PID) END) AS female_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Gender != 'Female' AND p.Gender IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(mc.PID) END) AS non_female_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Gender IS NULL THEN TRIM(mc.PID) END) AS unknown_count
    FROM Movie m
    JOIN M_Cast mc ON m.MID = mc.MID
    JOIN Person p ON TRIM(mc.PID) = p.PID
    GROUP BY m.MID, m.year
),
year_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        year_num,
        COUNT(*) AS total_movies,
        SUM(CASE WHEN non_female_count = 0 AND unknown_count = 0 AND total_cast > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exclusively_female_movies
    FROM movie_cast_stats
    GROUP BY year_num
)
SELECT 
    year_num AS year,
    total_movies,
    exclusively_female_movies,
    1.0 * exclusively_female_movies / total_movies * 100 AS percentage
FROM year_stats
ORDER BY year

start_years AS (

counts AS (

WITH actor_years AS (

  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE mc.PID IS NOT NULL
    AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(m.year, -4) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_career AS (
  SELECT PID, MIN(year) as first_year, MAX(year) as last_year
  FROM actor_years
  GROUP BY PID
),
all_career_years AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.PID,
    ac.first_year,
    ac.last_year,
    ac.first_year + g.n AS year
  FROM actor_career ac
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(0, ac.last_year - ac.first_year)) AS g(n)
),
has_film AS (
  SELECT 
    acy.PID,
    acy.year,
    CASE WHEN ay.year IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_film
  FROM all_career_years acy
  LEFT JOIN actor_years ay ON acy.PID = ay.PID AND acy.year = ay.year
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    year,
    has_film,
    year - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY year) AS gap_group
  FROM has_film
  WHERE has_film = 0
),
gap_sizes AS (
  SELECT PID, gap_group, COUNT(*) AS gap_length
  FROM gaps
  GROUP BY PID, gap_group
),
actors_with_big_gaps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID
  FROM gap_sizes
  WHERE gap_length >= 4
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_actors_with_no_big_gaps

WHERE ac.PID NOT IN (SELECT PID FROM actors_with_big_gaps)

with_quintile AS (

            WHEN 1.0 * rank_count / total_students <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'

),
ent_top2 AS (

    FROM ent_ranked
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
),
cust_prefs AS (

           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 1 THEN StyleID END) as cust_style_1,
           MAX(CASE WHEN PreferenceSeq = 2 THEN StyleID END) as cust_style_2
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
),
ent_valid AS (

    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
),
cust_valid AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
)

JOIN cust_valid cv ON 1=1
JOIN cust_prefs cp ON cv.CustomerID = cp.CustomerID
JOIN Entertainers e ON ev.EntertainerID = e.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON cv.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id

           MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating

    GROUP BY dm.name_id
),
director_movie_gaps AS (
    SELECT name_id,
           movie_id,
           date_published,
           LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as prev_date
    FROM director_movies
),
director_avg_gap AS (
    SELECT name_id,

    FROM director_movie_gaps
    WHERE prev_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name_id
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT dm.name_id, n.name,
           COUNT(*) as movie_count,
           SUM(m.duration) as total_duration,
           dr.avg_rating_all,
           dr.total_votes_all,
           dr.min_rating,
           dr.max_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN director_ratings dr ON dm.name_id = dr.name_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id, n.name, dr.avg_rating_all, dr.total_votes_all, dr.min_rating, dr.max_rating
)
SELECT CAST(ds.name_id AS TEXT) as name_id,
       ds.name,
       CAST(ds.movie_count AS INTEGER) as movie_count,
       CAST(dag.avg_inter_movie_duration AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
       ROUND(ds.avg_rating_all, 2) as avg_rating,
       CAST(ds.total_votes_all AS INTEGER) as total_votes,
       ds.min_rating,
       ds.max_rating,
       CAST(ds.total_duration AS INTEGER) as total_movie_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN director_avg_gap dag ON ds.name_id = dag.name_id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_duration DESC

WITH txn_with_price AS (
  SELECT 
    bt.txn_id,
    bt.txn_date,
    bt.member_id,
    bm.region,
    bt.ticker,
    bt.txn_type,
    bt.quantity,
    bp.price,
    TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year
  FROM bitcoin_transactions bt
  JOIN bitcoin_members bm ON bt.member_id = bm.member_id
  JOIN bitcoin_prices bp ON bt.ticker = bp.ticker 
    AND TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(bt.txn_date, 1, 2) AS DATE) = TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(bp.market_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(bp.market_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(bp.market_date, 1, 2) AS DATE)
  WHERE bt.ticker = 'BTC' AND bt.txn_type = 'BUY'
),
region_year_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    year,
    SUM(quantity * price) AS total_dollar_amount,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(quantity * price) / SUM(quantity) AS avg_price
  FROM txn_with_price
  GROUP BY region, year
),
with_prev_year AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    year,
    total_dollar_amount,
    total_quantity,
    avg_price,
    LAG(avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY year) AS prev_avg_price
  FROM region_year_totals
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    year,
    total_dollar_amount,
    total_quantity,
    avg_price,
    prev_avg_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_price DESC) AS price_rank
  FROM with_prev_year
  WHERE year > 2017
)
SELECT 
  region,
  year,
  avg_price,
  price_rank,
  CASE 
    WHEN prev_avg_price IS NOT NULL AND prev_avg_price != 0 
    THEN 100.0 * (avg_price - prev_avg_price) / prev_avg_price
    ELSE NULL
  END AS pct_change
FROM ranked
ORDER BY year, price_rank

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(market_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 1, 2) AS DATE) AS date,
        volume,
        CASE 
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS DOUBLE) * 1000
            ELSE TRY_CAST(volume AS DOUBLE)
        END AS vol
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE TRY_CAST(SUBSTR(market_date, 7, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 4, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(market_date, 1, 2) AS DATE) BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND '2021-08-10'
),
with_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        ticker,
        date,
        volume,
        vol,
        LAG(vol) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY date) AS prev_vol
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT 
    ticker,
    date,
    volume,
    vol,
    prev_vol,
    CASE 
        WHEN prev_vol IS NOT NULL AND prev_vol > 0 THEN (vol - prev_vol) * 100.0 / prev_vol
        ELSE NULL
    END AS pct_change
FROM with_prev
ORDER BY ticker, date

-- Full query: find female legislators whose terms included Dec 31, group by first state, count, return only the top state
WITH dec31_dates AS (
    SELECT unnest(generate_series(date '1789-12-31', date '2025-12-31', INTERVAL '1 year'))::VARCHAR as dec31
),
terms_with_dec31 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT lt.id_bioguide
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN dec31_dates d ON lt.term_start <= d.dec31 AND lt.term_end >= d.dec31
),
first_state AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, lt.state as first_state
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'F'
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id_bioguide ORDER BY lt.term_start ASC, lt.term_number ASC) = 1
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT fs.first_state
    FROM first_state fs
    JOIN terms_with_dec31 t ON fs.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
)
SELECT first_state, COUNT(*) as count
FROM qualifying
GROUP BY first_state
ORDER BY count DESC

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, 
           MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    WHERE lt.term_start >= '1917-01-01' AND lt.term_start <= '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide
    HAVING MIN(lt.term_start) = (
        SELECT MIN(lt2.term_start) 
        FROM legislators_terms lt2 
        WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    )
),
years AS (
    SELECT CAST(n AS INTEGER) as year_num
    FROM generate_series(1, 20) AS g(n)
),
retention AS (
    SELECT y.year_num,
           c.id_bioguide,
           DATE_TRUNC('year', c.first_term_start::DATE + y.year_num * INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' as dec31_date,
           EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
               WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
                 AND DATE_TRUNC('year', c.first_term_start::DATE + y.year_num * INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' >= lt2.term_start::DATE 
                 AND DATE_TRUNC('year', c.first_term_start::DATE + y.year_num * INTERVAL '1 year')::DATE + INTERVAL '1 year' - INTERVAL '1 day' <= lt2.term_end::DATE
           ) as still_in_office
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN years y
)
SELECT year_num, 
       SUM(still_in_office)::DOUBLE / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
FROM retention
GROUP BY year_num
ORDER BY year_num

WITH first_terms AS (

        l.gender,
        lt.term_start::DATE as first_term_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', lt.term_start::DATE) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.state,
        ft.gender,
        ft.first_term_year,
        ft.first_term_year + INTERVAL '1' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY as check_date_0,
        ft.first_term_year + INTERVAL '3' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY as check_date_2,
        ft.first_term_year + INTERVAL '5' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY as check_date_4,
        ft.first_term_year + INTERVAL '7' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY as check_date_6,
        ft.first_term_year + INTERVAL '9' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY as check_date_8,
        ft.first_term_year + INTERVAL '11' YEAR - INTERVAL '1' DAY as check_date_10
    FROM first_terms ft
),
retained_flags AS (
    SELECT 
        r.id_bioguide,
        r.state,
        r.gender,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = r.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= r.check_date_0
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= r.check_date_0
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_0,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = r.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= r.check_date_2
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= r.check_date_2
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_2,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = r.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= r.check_date_4
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= r.check_date_4
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_4,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = r.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= r.check_date_6
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= r.check_date_6
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_6,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = r.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= r.check_date_8
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= r.check_date_8
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_8,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt2 
            WHERE lt2.id_bioguide = r.id_bioguide 
            AND lt2.term_start::DATE <= r.check_date_10
            AND lt2.term_end::DATE >= r.check_date_10
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as retained_10
    FROM retention r
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        SUM(retained_0) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_0,
        SUM(retained_2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_2,
        SUM(retained_4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_4,
        SUM(retained_6) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_6,
        SUM(retained_8) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_8,
        SUM(retained_10) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as retention_10
    FROM retained_flags
    GROUP BY state, gender
),
qualifying_states AS (
    SELECT state
    FROM state_gender_retention
    WHERE retention_0 > 0 AND retention_2 > 0 AND retention_4 > 0 AND retention_6 > 0 AND retention_8 > 0 AND retention_10 > 0
    GROUP BY state
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT sgr.state
FROM state_gender_retention sgr
JOIN qualifying_states qs ON sgr.state = qs.state
ORDER BY sgr.state

WITH male_la_legislators AS (

dec31_dates AS (

legislator_serving AS (

-- Final query: compute averages across all qualifying customers
WITH customer_first_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) as total_sales
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(amount) > 0
),
customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT 
        cf.customer_id,
        cf.first_payment_date,
        ct.total_sales,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cf.first_payment_date)) / 3600 <= 168 
            THEN p.amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) as sales_7days,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (p.payment_date - cf.first_payment_date)) / 3600 <= 720 
            THEN p.amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) as sales_30days
    FROM customer_first_payment cf
    JOIN customer_totals ct ON cf.customer_id = ct.customer_id
    JOIN payment p ON cf.customer_id = p.customer_id
    GROUP BY cf.customer_id, cf.first_payment_date, ct.total_sales
)
SELECT 
    AVG(sales_7days / total_sales * 100.0) as avg_pct_7days,
    AVG(sales_30days / total_sales * 100.0) as avg_pct_30days,
    AVG(total_sales) as avg_total_sales
FROM customer_ltv

WITH film_revenue AS (

actor_film_revenue AS (

),
ranked AS (

top3 AS (

-- Build the full analysis
WITH first_payment AS (
    -- Find the first payment date per customer
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date) as first_payment_date
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
first_rental AS (
    -- Find the rental_id of the first payment per customer
    SELECT p.customer_id, p.rental_id
    FROM payment p
    INNER JOIN first_payment fp ON p.customer_id = fp.customer_id AND p.payment_date = fp.first_payment_date
),
first_movie AS (
    -- Get the rating of the first movie rented per customer
    SELECT fr.customer_id, f.rating
    FROM first_rental fr
    INNER JOIN rental r ON fr.rental_id = r.rental_id
    INNER JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    INNER JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    -- Total amount spent and total rentals per customer
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        SUM(p.amount) as total_amount,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rental r2 WHERE r2.customer_id = p.customer_id) as total_rentals
    FROM payment p
    GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    fm.rating,
    AVG(ct.total_amount) as avg_total_amount_spent,
    AVG(ct.total_rentals - 1) as avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie fm
INNER JOIN customer_totals ct ON fm.customer_id = ct.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating

WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT t.customer_id, 
         CAST(date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS VARCHAR) as payment_month,
         SUM(p.amount) as total_amount
  FROM payment p
  JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
  GROUP BY t.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         payment_month,
         total_amount,
         LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_amount,
         LAG(payment_month) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month
  FROM monthly_payments
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         payment_month,
         prev_month,
         total_amount,
         prev_amount,
         ROUND(total_amount - prev_amount, 2) as month_over_month_diff,
         ABS(total_amount - prev_amount) as abs_diff
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE prev_amount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.customer_id,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name,
       SUBSTR(d.payment_month, 1, 7) as payment_month,
       ROUND(d.month_over_month_diff, 2) as month_over_month_diff
FROM diffs d
JOIN customer c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY d.abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH r_words AS (

  FROM r_words,

  GROUP BY words, LENGTH(words)
),
with_count AS (

-- Full query: find store with highest total orders and compute the delivered ratio
WITH store_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        s.store_id,
        ANY_VALUE(s.store_name) as store_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as total_orders
    FROM stores s
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id
),
top_store AS (
    SELECT store_id, store_name, total_orders
    FROM store_totals
    ORDER BY total_orders DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
delivered_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ts.store_id,
        ts.store_name,
        ts.total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_order_id) as delivered_orders
    FROM top_store ts
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON ts.store_id = o.store_id
    LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON o.delivery_order_id = d.delivery_order_id AND d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
    GROUP BY ts.store_id, ts.store_name, ts.total_orders
)
SELECT 
    store_name,
    total_orders,
    delivered_orders,
    1.0 * delivered_orders / total_orders as delivered_ratio
FROM delivered_counts

WITH feb_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        s.hub_id,
        COUNT(*) AS feb_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
      AND o.order_created_month = 2
    GROUP BY s.hub_id
),
mar_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        s.hub_id,
        COUNT(*) AS mar_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
      AND o.order_created_month = 3
    GROUP BY s.hub_id
)
SELECT 
    f.hub_id,
    h.hub_name,
    f.feb_orders,
    m.mar_orders,
    1.0 * (m.mar_orders - f.feb_orders) / f.feb_orders AS pct_increase
FROM feb_counts f
JOIN mar_counts m ON f.hub_id = m.hub_id
JOIN hubs h ON f.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE 1.0 * (m.mar_orders - f.feb_orders) / f.feb_orders > 0.20
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

    FROM order_lines ol
    JOIN inventory_wh1 inv ON ol.product_id = inv.product_id

WITH inv AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, i.qty, p.purchased,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.product_id ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty) as inv_rn
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
),
inv_totals AS (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(qty) as total_inv
    FROM inv
    GROUP BY product_id
),
orders AS (
    SELECT ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty as required_qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY o.ordered) as ord_rn
    FROM orderlines ol
    JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.id
),
cum_orders AS (
    SELECT product_id, order_id, required_qty, ord_rn,
           SUM(required_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ord_rn) as cum_demand
    FROM orders
),
order_fulfillment AS (
    SELECT co.product_id, co.order_id, co.required_qty, co.cum_demand,
           COALESCE(it.total_inv, 0) as total_inv,
           LEAST(co.cum_demand, COALESCE(it.total_inv, 0)) as cum_fulfilled,
           LEAST(
               COALESCE(LAG(co.cum_demand) OVER (PARTITION BY co.product_id ORDER BY co.ord_rn), 0),
               COALESCE(it.total_inv, 0)
           ) as prev_fulfilled
    FROM cum_orders co
    LEFT JOIN inv_totals it ON co.product_id = it.product_id
)
SELECT p.name,
       AVG(100.0 * (cum_fulfilled - prev_fulfilled) / required_qty) as avg_pick_pct
FROM order_fulfillment of2
JOIN products p ON of2.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name

-- Final answer: Products with ALL 12 months in 2017 having sales_ratio > 2
-- Using the interpretation from the documentation:
-- Window 1: 5 months before + 6 months after (including current month) = 12 months
-- Window 2: 6 months before + 5 months after (including current month) = 12 months
-- CMA = average of the two window averages
WITH sales AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, qty,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY mth) as rn
    FROM monthly_sales
),
cma_calc AS (
    SELECT s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.rn,
           AVG(s1.qty) as avg_window1,
           AVG(s2.qty) as avg_window2
    FROM sales s
    LEFT JOIN sales s1 ON s.product_id = s1.product_id AND s1.rn BETWEEN s.rn - 5 AND s.rn + 6
    LEFT JOIN sales s2 ON s.product_id = s2.product_id AND s2.rn BETWEEN s.rn - 6 AND s.rn + 5
    WHERE s.rn BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY s.product_id, s.mth, s.qty, s.rn
),
ratios AS (
    SELECT p.id as product_id, p.name as product_name, c.mth,
           c.qty / ((c.avg_window1 + c.avg_window2) / 2.0) as sales_ratio
    FROM cma_calc c
    JOIN products p ON p.id = c.product_id
    WHERE c.mth >= '2017-01-01' AND c.mth <= '2017-12-01'
),
product_check AS (
    SELECT product_id, product_name,
           COUNT(*) as total_months,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sales_ratio > 2) as above_2_months
    FROM ratios
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name
)
SELECT product_id, product_name, total_months, above_2_months
FROM product_check
WHERE above_2_months = total_months
ORDER BY product_id

        (AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 5 AND d.tstep + 6 THEN w.qty END) +
         AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 6 AND d.tstep + 5 THEN w.qty END)) / 2.0 AS cma,
        CASE WHEN (AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 5 AND d.tstep + 6 THEN w.qty END) +
                   AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 6 AND d.tstep + 5 THEN w.qty END)) / 2.0 IS NOT NULL 
             AND (AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 5 AND d.tstep + 6 THEN w.qty END) +
                  AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 6 AND d.tstep + 5 THEN w.qty END)) / 2.0 != 0 
             THEN d.qty * 1.0 / ((AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 5 AND d.tstep + 6 THEN w.qty END) +
                                  AVG(CASE WHEN w.tstep BETWEEN d.tstep - 6 AND d.tstep + 5 THEN w.qty END)) / 2.0) 
             ELSE NULL END AS ratio
    FROM data d
    LEFT JOIN data w ON d.product_id = w.product_id
    GROUP BY d.product_id, d.mth, d.qty, d.tstep, d.month_of_year
),
seasonal AS (
    SELECT product_id, month_of_year, AVG(ratio) AS raw_seasonal_index
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE tstep BETWEEN 7 AND 30
      AND ratio IS NOT NULL AND ratio != 0
    GROUP BY product_id, month_of_year
),
seasonal_norm AS (
    SELECT product_id, month_of_year, 
           raw_seasonal_index / AVG(raw_seasonal_index) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS seasonal_index
    FROM seasonal
),
weighted_means AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           SUM(tstep) AS W,
           SUM(tstep * tstep) AS sum_wx,
           SUM(tstep * cma) AS sum_wy
    FROM cma_calc
    WHERE cma IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY product_id
),
weighted_means2 AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           W,
           sum_wx / W AS x_bar,
           sum_wy / W AS y_bar
    FROM weighted_means
),
weighted_cov AS (
    SELECT c.product_id,
           SUM(tstep * (tstep - wm.x_bar) * (cma - wm.y_bar)) AS S_xy,
           SUM(tstep * (tstep - wm.x_bar) * (tstep - wm.x_bar)) AS S_xx
    FROM cma_calc c
    JOIN weighted_means2 wm ON c.product_id = wm.product_id
    WHERE c.cma IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.product_id, wm.x_bar, wm.y_bar
),
reg_params AS (
    SELECT wc.product_id,
           wc.S_xy / wc.S_xx AS slope,
           wm.y_bar - (wc.S_xy / wc.S_xx) * wm.x_bar AS intercept
    FROM weighted_cov wc
    JOIN weighted_means2 wm ON wc.product_id = wm.product_id
),
forecast_cma AS (
    SELECT d.product_id, d.month_of_year, d.tstep,
           r.slope * d.tstep + r.intercept AS forecast_cma
    FROM reg_params r
    JOIN data d ON r.product_id = d.product_id
    WHERE d.tstep BETWEEN 25 AND 36
),
forecast_final AS (
    SELECT f.product_id, f.month_of_year, f.tstep, f.forecast_cma,
           f.forecast_cma * sn.seasonal_index AS forecast_qty
    FROM forecast_cma f
    JOIN seasonal_norm sn ON f.product_id = sn.product_id AND f.month_of_year = sn.month_of_year
)
SELECT AVG(forecasted_annual_sales_2018) AS average_forecasted_annual_sales
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, 
           SUM(forecast_qty) AS forecasted_annual_sales_2018
    FROM forecast_final
    GROUP BY product_id
)

WITH RECURSIVE inventory_model AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS product_id,
        0 AS month_offset,
        it.qty AS ending_inventory
    FROM products p
    JOIN inventory_totals it ON p.id = it.product_id
    WHERE p.id IN (6520, 6600)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        im.month_offset + 1,
        CASE 
            WHEN im.ending_inventory - mb.qty < pm.qty_minimum 
            THEN im.ending_inventory - mb.qty + pm.qty_purchase
            ELSE im.ending_inventory - mb.qty
        END AS ending_inventory
    FROM inventory_model im
    JOIN monthly_budget mb ON im.product_id = mb.product_id 
        AND mb.mth = CAST(TRY_CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST('2018-12-01' AS DATE) + (im.month_offset + 1) * INTERVAL '1 month') AS DATE) AS VARCHAR)
    JOIN product_minimums pm ON im.product_id = pm.product_id
    WHERE im.month_offset < 12
)
SELECT 
    im.product_id,
    CAST(TRY_CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST('2018-12-01' AS DATE) + im.month_offset * INTERVAL '1 month') AS DATE) AS VARCHAR) AS mth,
    ABS(im.ending_inventory - pm.qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
FROM inventory_model im
JOIN product_minimums pm ON im.product_id = pm.product_id
WHERE im.month_offset >= 1 AND im.month_offset <= 12
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.product_id ORDER BY ABS(im.ending_inventory - pm.qty_minimum), im.month_offset) = 1

-- Find the champion team for each season-league combination
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        l.name AS league,
        c.name AS country,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE 
            WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
            WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS points
    FROM Match m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league,
        country,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league, country, team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    tp.season,
    tp.league,
    tp.country,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    tp.total_points
FROM team_points tp
JOIN Team t ON tp.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tp.season, tp.league ORDER BY tp.total_points DESC, tp.team_api_id ASC) = 1
ORDER BY tp.season, tp.league

WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss_rate,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS stddev_loss_rate
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
categories AS (
  SELECT 
    v."loss_rate_%",
    s.avg_loss_rate,
    s.stddev_loss_rate,
    (s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) AS lower_bound,
    (s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) AS upper_bound,
    CASE 
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" < (s.avg_loss_rate - s.stddev_loss_rate) THEN 'below'
      WHEN v."loss_rate_%" > (s.avg_loss_rate + s.stddev_loss_rate) THEN 'above'
      ELSE 'within'
    END AS category
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
)
SELECT 
  avg_loss_rate,
  stddev_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'below' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_below,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'within' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_within,
  SUM(CASE WHEN category = 'above' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS count_above,
  COUNT(*) AS total_items
FROM categories
GROUP BY avg_loss_rate, stddev_loss_rate

WITH wholesale AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        CAST(SUBSTR(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        ROUND(AVG(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MIN(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
        ROUND(MAX(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
        ROUND(SUM(vw."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS total_wholesale_price
    FROM veg_whsle_df vw
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vw.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, CAST(SUBSTR(vw.whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
selling AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        CAST(SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        ROUND(SUM(vt."qty_sold(kg)" * vt."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) AS total_selling_price
    FROM veg_txn_df vt
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vt.item_code = vc.item_code
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    AND vt."sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY vc.category_name, CAST(SUBSTR(vt.txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)
),
loss_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        vc.category_name,
        ROUND(AVG(vlr."loss_rate_%"), 2) AS avg_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df vlr
    JOIN veg_cat vc ON vlr.item_code = vc.item_code
    GROUP BY vc.category_name
)
SELECT 
    w.category_name,
    w.year,
    w.avg_wholesale_price,
    w.max_wholesale_price,
    w.min_wholesale_price,
    w.wholesale_price_difference,
    w.total_wholesale_price,
    s.total_selling_price,
    l.avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(w.total_wholesale_price * l.avg_loss_rate / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(s.total_selling_price - w.total_wholesale_price, 2) AS profit
FROM wholesale w
JOIN selling s ON w.category_name = s.category_name AND w.year = s.year
JOIN loss_rates l ON w.category_name = l.category_name
ORDER BY w.year, w.category_name

-- Final comprehensive seller performance report
WITH seller_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        seller_id,
        COUNT(*) as total_quantity,
        SUM(price) as total_sales,
        AVG(price) as avg_item_price
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
seller_reviews AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(orv.review_score) as avg_review_score
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN order_reviews orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        AVG(
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CAST(o.order_delivered_carrier_date AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(o.order_approved_at AS TIMESTAMP))) / 86400.0
        ) as avg_packing_time_days
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL 
      AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_top_category AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.seller_id,
        pcat.product_category_name_english as top_category
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pcat ON p.product_category_name = pcat.product_category_name
    GROUP BY oi.seller_id, pcat.product_category_name_english
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) = 1
)
SELECT 
    ss.seller_id,
    s.seller_city,
    s.seller_state,
    ss.total_quantity,
    ss.total_sales,
    ss.avg_item_price,
    sr.avg_review_score,
    sp.avg_packing_time_days,
    stc.top_category
FROM seller_sales ss
JOIN seller_reviews sr ON ss.seller_id = sr.seller_id
JOIN seller_packing sp ON ss.seller_id = sp.seller_id
JOIN seller_top_category stc ON ss.seller_id = stc.seller_id
JOIN sellers s ON ss.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE ss.total_quantity > 100
ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC

-- Final query
WITH monthly_nets AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE) AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                 WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                 ELSE 0 END) AS monthly_net
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY customer_id, date_trunc('month', txn_date::DATE)
),
with_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        monthly_net,
        SUM(monthly_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS closing_balance
    FROM monthly_nets
),
with_growth AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        closing_balance,
        LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance
    FROM with_balance
),
latest AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        closing_balance,
        prev_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rn
    FROM with_growth
),
growth_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        closing_balance AS current_balance,
        prev_balance,
        CASE 
            WHEN prev_balance IS NULL THEN NULL
            WHEN prev_balance = 0 THEN current_balance * 100
            ELSE (current_balance - prev_balance) * 100.0 / prev_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM latest
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 500 * 100 AS percentage_above_5
FROM growth_calc

-- Verify stability
WITH txn_with_rownum AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, txn_type, txn_amount,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date) as row_num,
    CASE 
      WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
      WHEN txn_type IN ('purchase', 'withdrawal') THEN -txn_amount
    END as net_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
),
running_balance AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date, row_num, net_amount,
    SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date, row_num ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) as cumulative_balance
  FROM txn_with_rownum
),
month_boundaries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT substr(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' as month_1st 
  FROM customer_transactions
  ORDER BY month_1st
),
customer_monthly_balance AS (
  SELECT mb.month_1st, rb.customer_id, rb.cumulative_balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mb.month_1st, rb.customer_id ORDER BY rb.txn_date DESC, rb.row_num DESC) as rn
  FROM month_boundaries mb
  CROSS JOIN running_balance rb
  WHERE rb.txn_date <= mb.month_1st
),
latest_balance AS (
  SELECT month_1st, customer_id, cumulative_balance
  FROM customer_monthly_balance
  WHERE rn = 1
),
monthly_total AS (
  SELECT month_1st, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN cumulative_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE cumulative_balance END) as total_balance
  FROM latest_balance
  GROUP BY month_1st
)
SELECT month_1st as month, total_balance
FROM monthly_total
WHERE month_1st != (SELECT MIN(month_1st) FROM monthly_total)
ORDER BY month_1st

-- Try using strftime for proper date formatting
WITH daily_net AS (
  SELECT customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE) as txn_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) as daily_net
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(txn_date AS DATE)
),
customer_dates AS (
  SELECT customer_id, 
    MIN(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as first_date,
    MAX(CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as last_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
all_dates AS (
  SELECT cd.customer_id, 
    cd.first_date + CAST(g AS BIGINT) * INTERVAL '1 day' as date
  FROM customer_dates cd,
  UNNEST(generate_series(0, 90)) AS t(g)
  WHERE CAST(g AS BIGINT) <= (CAST(cd.last_date AS DATE) - CAST(cd.first_date AS DATE))
),
daily_filled AS (
  SELECT ad.customer_id, ad.date, COALESCE(dn.daily_net, 0) as daily_net
  FROM all_dates ad
  LEFT JOIN daily_net dn ON ad.customer_id = dn.customer_id AND ad.date = dn.txn_date
),
running_balance AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date, daily_net,
    SUM(daily_net) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as balance
  FROM daily_filled
),
rolling_avg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date, balance,
    AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as rolling_avg_30d
  FROM running_balance
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT ra.customer_id, ra.date, ra.balance, ra.rolling_avg_30d,
    cd.first_date
  FROM rolling_avg ra
  JOIN customer_dates cd ON ra.customer_id = cd.customer_id
  WHERE ra.date >= cd.first_date + 29 * INTERVAL '1 day'
),
with_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, date, 
    GREATEST(rolling_avg_30d, 0) as rolling_avg_clamped,
    first_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', date) as month_start
  FROM qualified
),
first_months AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(first_date) as first_date
  FROM customer_dates
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
non_first AS (
  SELECT wm.*
  FROM with_month wm
  JOIN first_months fm ON wm.customer_id = fm.customer_id
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', wm.first_date) != DATE_TRUNC('month', wm.date)
),
max_per_customer_month AS (
  SELECT customer_id, month_start,
    MAX(rolling_avg_clamped) as max_avg
  FROM non_first
  GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
)
SELECT 
  CAST(month_start AS DATE) as month,
  SUM(max_avg) as total_max_avg
FROM max_per_customer_month
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start

WITH RECURSIVE date_range AS (
    SELECT ('2020-01-01'::DATE + seq * INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS txn_date
    FROM generate_series(0, 118) AS t(seq)
),
customer_date AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, d.txn_date
    FROM customer_transactions c
    CROSS JOIN date_range d
),
daily_txn AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) AS daily_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
base_data AS (
    SELECT cd.customer_id, cd.txn_date,
           COALESCE(dt.daily_change, 0) AS daily_change,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cd.customer_id ORDER BY cd.txn_date) AS rn
    FROM customer_date cd
    LEFT JOIN daily_txn dt ON cd.customer_id = dt.customer_id AND cd.txn_date = dt.txn_date
),
recursive_bal AS (
    SELECT customer_id, txn_date, daily_change, daily_change AS balance, rn
    FROM base_data
    WHERE rn = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT b.customer_id, b.txn_date, b.daily_change,
           GREATEST(0, rb.balance + b.daily_change) AS balance, b.rn
    FROM base_data b
    JOIN recursive_bal rb ON b.customer_id = rb.customer_id AND b.rn = rb.rn + 1
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date)::DATE AS month_start,
           customer_id,
           MAX(balance) AS max_daily_balance
    FROM recursive_bal
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', txn_date)::DATE, customer_id
)
SELECT month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as customer_count, SUM(max_daily_balance) AS monthly_total
FROM monthly_max
GROUP BY month_start
ORDER BY month_start

-- Calculate percentage change in sales for each year
-- Pre: weeks 21-24 (leading up to June 15)
-- Post: weeks 25-28 (following June 15)
SELECT 
    calendar_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END) as pre_sales,
    SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN sales END) as post_sales,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 25 AND 28 THEN sales END) - SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 21 AND 24 THEN sales END) as pct_change
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
WHERE calendar_year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
GROUP BY calendar_year
ORDER BY calendar_year

-- Build the full analysis for all attribute types
-- For each attribute type, calculate avg percentage change across all attribute values
WITH region_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region as attr_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_before,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 36
    GROUP BY region
),
region_pct AS (
    SELECT 
        attr_value,
        1.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / sales_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM region_sales
    WHERE sales_before > 0
),
platform_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        platform as attr_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_before,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 36
    GROUP BY platform
),
platform_pct AS (
    SELECT 
        attr_value,
        1.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / sales_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM platform_sales
    WHERE sales_before > 0
),
age_band_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        age_band as attr_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_before,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 36
    GROUP BY age_band
),
age_band_pct AS (
    SELECT 
        attr_value,
        1.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / sales_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM age_band_sales
    WHERE sales_before > 0
),
demographic_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        demographic as attr_value,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_before,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 36
    GROUP BY demographic
),
demographic_pct AS (
    SELECT 
        attr_value,
        1.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / sales_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM demographic_sales
    WHERE sales_before > 0
),
customer_type_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_type as attr_value,

        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36 THEN sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 36
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
customer_type_pct AS (
    SELECT 
        attr_value,
        1.0 * (sales_after - sales_before) / sales_before * 100 as pct_change
    FROM customer_type_sales
    WHERE sales_before > 0
)
SELECT 'region' as attribute_type, AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
FROM region_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'platform', AVG(pct_change) FROM platform_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'age_band', AVG(pct_change) FROM age_band_pct
UNION ALL
SELECT 'demographic', AVG(pct_change) FROM demographic_pct

SELECT 'customer_type', AVG(pct_change) FROM customer_type_pct
