WITH last_race AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
top_driver AS (
    SELECT lr.year, ds.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON lr.last_race_id = ds.race_id
    JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
    WHERE ds.position = 1
),
top_constructor AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name as constructor_name, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM last_race lr
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON lr.last_race_id = cs.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE cs.position = 1
)
SELECT td.year,
       td.forename || ' ' || td.surname as driver_full_name,
       td.driver_points,
       tc.constructor_name,
       tc.constructor_points
FROM top_driver td
JOIN top_constructor tc ON td.year = tc.year
ORDER BY td.year

-- Build the full query: max driver points per year, max constructor points per year, sum them, order ascending, take 3
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, driver_id, SUM(res.points) AS driver_total
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, driver_id
),
max_driver AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(driver_total) AS max_driver_pts
    FROM driver_points
    GROUP BY year
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, constructor_id, SUM(res.points) AS constructor_total
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, constructor_id
),
max_constructor AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(constructor_total) AS max_constructor_pts
    FROM constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    md.year,
    md.max_driver_pts,
    mc.max_constructor_pts,
    md.max_driver_pts + mc.max_constructor_pts AS total
FROM max_driver md
JOIN max_constructor mc ON md.year = mc.year
ORDER BY total ASC
LIMIT 3

-- Final query: top 3 (constructor, year) combinations by combined points
-- Best driver = team_driver_rank = 1
WITH last_races AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(race_id) as last_race_id
    FROM races
    GROUP BY year
),
best_drivers AS (
    SELECT tdr.year, tdr.constructor_id, tdr.driver_id
    FROM team_driver_ranks tdr
    WHERE CAST(CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) = 1
),
driver_season_points AS (
    SELECT br.year, br.constructor_id, br.driver_id, ds.points as driver_points
    FROM best_drivers br
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON ds.driver_id = br.driver_id AND ds.race_id = (SELECT last_race_id FROM last_races WHERE year = br.year)
),
constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT lr.year, cs.constructor_id, cs.points as constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN last_races lr ON cs.race_id = lr.last_race_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        br.year,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        br.constructor_id,
        dsp.driver_points,
        csp.constructor_points,
        dsp.driver_points + csp.constructor_points as combined_points
    FROM best_drivers br
    JOIN driver_season_points dsp ON dsp.year = br.year AND dsp.constructor_id = br.constructor_id
    JOIN constructor_season_points csp ON csp.year = br.year AND csp.constructor_id = br.constructor_id
    JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = br.constructor_id
)
SELECT constructor_name, year, combined_points
FROM combined
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH sessions_with_input AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_input
    FROM form_log 
    WHERE path = '/regist/input'
    GROUP BY session
),
sessions_with_confirm AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_confirm
    FROM form_log 
    WHERE path = '/regist/confirm'
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT 
    i.session,
    i.first_input,
    c.first_confirm
FROM sessions_with_input i
JOIN sessions_with_confirm c ON i.session = c.session

-- For each page, count unique sessions where it appears as landing OR exit (or both)
WITH landing AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, path AS page
  FROM (
    SELECT session, path,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp ASC) AS rn_asc
    FROM activity_log
  )
  WHERE rn_asc = 1
),
exit_pages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, path AS page
  FROM (
    SELECT session, path,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp DESC) AS rn_desc
    FROM activity_log
  )
  WHERE rn_desc = 1
)
SELECT page, COUNT(*) AS unique_sessions
FROM (
  SELECT session, page FROM landing
  UNION
  SELECT session, page FROM exit_pages
)
GROUP BY page
ORDER BY unique_sessions DESC, page

WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT stamp, session, path,
        CASE WHEN length(path) > 1 AND right(path, 1) = '/' THEN left(path, length(path) - 1) ELSE path END as norm_path
    FROM activity_log
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, norm_path) as rn
    FROM deduped
),
detail_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        n1.session,
        n1.rn as first_detail_rn,
        n2.rn as second_detail_rn
    FROM numbered n1
    JOIN numbered n2 
        ON n1.session = n2.session 
        AND n2.rn = n1.rn + 1
    WHERE n1.norm_path = '/detail' AND n2.norm_path = '/detail'
),
third_page AS (
    SELECT 
        n3.norm_path as third_page_path
    FROM detail_pairs dp
    JOIN numbered n3 
        ON dp.session = n3.session 
        AND n3.rn = dp.second_detail_rn + 1
    WHERE n3.norm_path IS NOT NULL AND n3.norm_path != ''
)
SELECT third_page_path, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM third_page
GROUP BY third_page_path
ORDER BY cnt DESC, third_page_path
LIMIT 3

-- Top 5 constructors by number of seasons where they had the fewest total points
WITH season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name, SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM races r
    JOIN results res ON r.race_id = res.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON res.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, c.constructor_id, c.name
),
point_scoring_constructors AS (
    SELECT * FROM season_points WHERE total_points > 0
),
min_points_per_year AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(total_points) as min_pts
    FROM point_scoring_constructors
    GROUP BY year
),
least_constructors AS (
    SELECT psc.year, psc.constructor_id, psc.name, psc.total_points
    FROM point_scoring_constructors psc
    JOIN min_points_per_year mpy ON psc.year = mpy.year
    WHERE psc.total_points = mpy.min_pts
)
SELECT name, COUNT(*) as season_count
FROM least_constructors
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, name
LIMIT 5

WITH pos_data AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap, position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap BETWEEN 0 AND 5
),
overtakes AS (
    SELECT 
        p1.race_id,
        p1.driver_id as overtaker_id,
        p1.lap,
        p1.position as new_pos,
        p0.position as old_pos
    FROM pos_data p1
    LEFT JOIN pos_data p0 ON p1.race_id = p0.race_id 
        AND p1.driver_id = p0.driver_id 
        AND p1.lap = p0.lap + 1
    WHERE p1.lap BETWEEN 1 AND 5 
        AND p0.lap IS NOT NULL
        AND p1.position < p0.position
),
overtaken_driver AS (
    SELECT o.*, 
        pd.driver_id as actual_overtaken_id
    FROM overtakes o
    LEFT JOIN pos_data pd ON o.race_id = pd.race_id 
        AND pd.lap = o.lap - 1 
        AND pd.position = o.new_pos
),
grid_pos AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, position as grid_pos
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE lap = 0
),
retirements AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, TRY_CAST(CAST(lap AS TEXT) AS INT) as retire_lap
    FROM retirements
    WHERE TRY_CAST(CAST(lap AS TEXT) AS INT) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
),
pit_stops AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap as pit_lap
    FROM pit_stops
    WHERE lap BETWEEN 1 AND 5
),
classified AS (
    SELECT 
        od.*,
        gp_overtaker.grid_pos as overtaker_grid,
        gp_overtaken.grid_pos as overtaken_grid
    FROM overtaken_driver od
    LEFT JOIN grid_pos gp_overtaker ON od.race_id = gp_overtaker.race_id AND od.overtaker_id = gp_overtaker.driver_id
    LEFT JOIN grid_pos gp_overtaken ON od.race_id = gp_overtaken.race_id AND od.actual_overtaken_id = gp_overtaken.driver_id
),
final AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN c.lap = 1 AND c.overtaken_grid IS NOT NULL AND ABS(c.overtaker_grid - c.overtaken_grid) <= 2 THEN 'Start-related overtakes'
            WHEN c.actual_overtaken_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM retirements r 
                WHERE r.race_id = c.race_id AND r.driver_id = c.actual_overtaken_id 
                    AND r.retire_lap = c.lap
            ) THEN 'Retirements'
            WHEN c.actual_overtaken_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM pit_stops p 
                WHERE p.race_id = c.race_id AND p.driver_id = c.actual_overtaken_id 
                    AND p.pit_lap IN (c.lap, c.lap - 1)
            ) THEN 'Pit Stops'
            ELSE 'Standard on-track passes'
        END as category
    FROM classified c
)
SELECT category, COUNT(*) as count FROM final GROUP BY category ORDER BY category

WITH driver_season AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        constructor_id,
        first_round,
        last_round
    FROM drives
    WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
      AND CAST(drive_id AS VARCHAR) != '-1'
),
constructor_first AS (
    SELECT ds.year, ds.driver_id, ds.constructor_id
    FROM driver_season ds
    WHERE ds.first_round = (
        SELECT MIN(ds2.first_round)
        FROM driver_season ds2
        WHERE ds2.year = ds.year AND ds2.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    )
),
constructor_last AS (
    SELECT ds.year, ds.driver_id, ds.constructor_id
    FROM driver_season ds
    WHERE ds.last_round = (
        SELECT MAX(ds2.last_round)
        FROM driver_season ds2
        WHERE ds2.year = ds.year AND ds2.driver_id = ds.driver_id
    )
),
distinct_rounds AS (
    SELECT r.driver_id, ra.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.round) as num_rounds
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
    GROUP BY r.driver_id, ra.year
),
qualified AS (
    SELECT 
        dr.year,
        dr.driver_id,
        dr.num_rounds,
        cf.constructor_id
    FROM distinct_rounds dr
    INNER JOIN constructor_first cf ON dr.year = cf.year AND dr.driver_id = cf.driver_id
    INNER JOIN constructor_last cl ON dr.year = cl.year AND dr.driver_id = cl.driver_id
    WHERE dr.num_rounds >= 2
      AND cf.constructor_id = cl.constructor_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.driver_id,

    d.surname,
    d.driver_ref
FROM qualified q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driver_id = d.driver_id
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename

-- Full query with all needed columns
WITH ordered_drives AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, first_round, last_round,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id ORDER BY first_round) as stint_num
    FROM drives
    WHERE constructor_id != -1
),
consecutive_pairs AS (
    SELECT a.year, a.driver_id, a.constructor_id as prev_constructor, a.last_round as prev_last,
           b.constructor_id as next_constructor, b.first_round as next_first,
           b.stint_num
    FROM ordered_drives a
    JOIN ordered_drives b ON a.year = b.year AND a.driver_id = b.driver_id AND a.stint_num = b.stint_num - 1
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, prev_constructor, next_constructor, prev_last, next_first,
           prev_last + 1 as first_missed, next_first - 1 as last_missed,
           (next_first - prev_last - 1) as races_missed,
           stint_num
    FROM consecutive_pairs
    WHERE next_first > prev_last + 1
),
driver_year_totals AS (
    SELECT year, driver_id, SUM(races_missed) as total_races_missed
    FROM gaps
    GROUP BY year, driver_id
),
first_gap AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (year, driver_id) year, driver_id, prev_constructor as constructor_before_first_missed,
           first_missed as overall_first_missed
    FROM gaps
    ORDER BY year, driver_id, first_missed
),
last_gap AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (year, driver_id) year, driver_id, next_constructor as constructor_after_last_missed,
           last_missed as overall_last_missed
    FROM gaps
    ORDER BY year, driver_id, last_missed
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT dyt.year, dyt.driver_id, dyt.total_races_missed,
           fg.overall_first_missed, fg.constructor_before_first_missed,
           lg.overall_last_missed, lg.constructor_after_last_missed
    FROM driver_year_totals dyt
    JOIN first_gap fg ON dyt.year = fg.year AND dyt.driver_id = fg.driver_id
    JOIN last_gap lg ON dyt.year = lg.year AND dyt.driver_id = lg.driver_id
    WHERE dyt.total_races_missed < 3
      AND fg.constructor_before_first_missed != lg.constructor_after_last_missed
)
SELECT AVG(overall_first_missed) as avg_first_round, AVG(overall_last_missed) as avg_last_round
FROM qualifying

WITH user_ages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id,
        CAST(date_diff('year', birth_date::DATE, CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) as age_years
    FROM mst_users
),
categories AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
            ELSE 'others'
        END AS age_category
    FROM user_ages
)
SELECT
    age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM categories
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY
    CASE age_category
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN '50s' THEN 4
        WHEN 'others' THEN 5
    END

WITH first_detail AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) as first_detail_or_complete
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path LIKE '/detail%' OR path LIKE '/complete%'
    GROUP BY session
),
pre_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        fd.session,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN al.search_type != '' AND al.stamp < fd.first_detail_or_complete THEN 1 END) as pre_event_count
    FROM first_detail fd
    LEFT JOIN activity_log al ON al.session = fd.session
    GROUP BY fd.session
),
min_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) as min_count FROM pre_counts
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT pc.session, pc.pre_event_count
    FROM pre_counts pc, min_count mc
    WHERE pc.pre_event_count = mc.min_count
),
first_detail_events AS (
    SELECT fd.session, al.path, al.search_type,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fd.session ORDER BY al.stamp, al.path) as rn
    FROM first_detail fd
    JOIN activity_log al ON al.session = fd.session AND al.stamp = fd.first_detail_or_complete
    WHERE al.path LIKE '/detail%' OR al.path LIKE '/complete%'
)
SELECT q.session, fde.path, fde.search_type
FROM qualifying q
JOIN first_detail_events fde ON fde.session = q.session AND fde.rn = 1
ORDER BY q.session
